name: Missing Milk Carton
look: A photo of a small white milk carton against a gray background. The front reads "MISSING" in red above a blank white box for a photo, then "HAVE YOU SEEN ME?" in red and "If found, contact" above a blank strip. The side says "MILK!" and "2% Reduced Fat Milk".
use: Parodies old missing-person milk cartons. The blank photo box gets a picture or name of something that has vanished from someone's life, like motivation, a sock or a friend who stopped replying, and the contact line says who wants it back.
slots: the blank photo box: what is missing
the strip after "If found, contact": who to contact
examples: My motivation, last seen Monday morning
Whoever sat on the couch last
describe: milk carton that says missing have you seen me
missing person ad on the side of a milk box
dairy carton with a blank spot for a missing photo
white milk container with red missing text and an empty picture
lost poster printed on a carton of milk
origin: Parodies the missing-children photos printed on US milk cartons in the 1980s.
